knowledge:
- key_parameters: estimationType=Specifies the method for defining library size in getLibsizes3 (e.g., "total") ;; mean_cutoff=The threshold value for filtering out low-abundance transcripts in simpleFilter (e.g., 0.01) ;; counts=Logical value in simpleFilter indicating whether filtering is based on raw counts or RPKM (e.g., FALSE) ;; groupings=The metadata column name in rowData indicating gene groupings (e.g., "annotation.ZA" or "annotation.Chromosome") ;; treatment1=The first treatment group name for relative ratio comparisons (e.g., "Male") ;; treatment2=The second treatment group name for relative ratio comparisons (e.g., "Female") ;; LOG2=Logical value in generateStats and test_diffs indicating whether to apply log2 transformation (e.g., FALSE)
- alternatives: The PMCMRplus package (specifically the Nemenyi test) is recommended for follow-up non-parametric post-hoc pairwise comparisons after a significant Kruskal-Wallis test.
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing RNA-seq read count data to assess sex chromosome dosage compensation, or more broadly, to compare absolute or relative gene expression distributions across pre-defined gene groupings (like chromosomes) and biological treatments (like sexes).
- pitfalls: Failing to effectively remove "unexpressed" loci can cause spurious results if they are disproportionately represented among chromosomes. Conversely, overly aggressive removal of low-abundance transcripts can artificially compress distributions of gene expression, masking true differences in the data.

workflows.name: dosage_compensation_analysis
workflows.intent: Assess sex chromosome dosage compensation by normalizing RNA-seq counts, filtering unexpressed genes, and comparing absolute and relative expression across chromosomes or gene groups.
input: readcounts.matrix (matrix of raw RNA-seq read counts with replicates in columns and transcripts in rows)
trxLength.vector (numeric vector of transcript lengths in basepairs)
chromosome.vector (vector indicating chromosomal linkage or gene grouping for each transcript)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare metadata and construct a SummarizedExperiment object containing counts, column data (treatments), and row data (annotations and transcript lengths) ;; 2. Calculate library sizes using getLibsizes3 ;; 3. Calculate RPKM values using make_RPKM ;; 4. Filter out unexpressed or low-abundance loci using simpleFilter ;; 5. Visualize absolute expression levels using plotExpr and calculate absolute expression statistics using generateStats ;; 6. Visualize relative expression ratios using plotRatioBoxes and plotRatioDensity, and perform statistical tests on ratios using test_diffs.
workflows.code:
library(doseR)
library(SummarizedExperiment)

data(hmel.data.doser)

reps <- c("Male", "Male", "Male", "Female", "Female", "Female")

annotxn <- data.frame("Chromosome" = factor(hmel.dat$chromosome, 
levels = 1:21))
annotxn$ZA <- factor(ifelse(hmel.dat$chromosome == 21, "Z", "A"), 
levels = c("A", "Z"))


counts <- hmel.dat$readcounts
colData <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(Treatment=as.factor(reps), 
row.names=colnames(hmel.dat$readcounts))
rowData <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(annotation = annotxn, 
seglens = hmel.dat$trxLength,
row.names=rownames(hmel.dat$readcounts) )
se2 <- SummarizedExperiment(assays=list(counts=counts), 
colData=colData, rowData=rowData)

SummarizedExperiment::colData(se2)$Libsizes <- getLibsizes3(se2, 
estimationType = "total")

SummarizedExperiment::assays(se2)$rpkm <- make_RPKM(se2)

data(hmel.se)

plotMA.se(se, samplesA ="Male", samplesB = "Female", cex = .2 , 
pch = 19, col = rgb(0,0,0, .2), xlab = "Log2(Average RPKM)", 
ylab = "Log2(Male:Female)")

f_se <- simpleFilter(se, mean_cutoff = 0.01, counts = FALSE)

plotExpr(f_se, groupings = "annotation.ZA", clusterby_grouping = FALSE, 
col=c("grey80","red","grey80","red"), notch=TRUE, ylab = "Log2(RPKM)")

se.male <- f_se[, colData(f_se)$Treatment == "Male"]
male_ZvA <- generateStats(se.male , groupings = "annotation.ZA", LOG2 = FALSE)
male_ZvA$summary
male_ZvA$kruskal
lapply(male_ZvA$data, head)

plotExpr(f_se, groupings = "annotation.Chromosome", col=c(rep("grey80", 20), 
"red"), notch=TRUE, ylab = "Log2(RPKM)", las = 2, treatment = "Male",  
clusterby_grouping = TRUE )

plotRatioBoxes(f_se, groupings = "annotation.ZA", treatment1 = "Male", 
treatment2 = "Female", outline = FALSE, col = c("grey80", "red"),
ylab = "Log(Male:Female)" )

plotRatioDensity(f_se, groupings = "annotation.ZA", treatment1 = "Male", 
treatment2 = "Female", type = "l", xlab = "Log(Male:Female)", ylab = "Density")

par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plotRatioBoxes(f_se, groupings = "annotation.Chromosome", treatment1 =
"Male", treatment2 = "Female", outline = FALSE, col=c(rep("grey80", 20), 
"red"), ylab = "Log(Male:Female)", xlab = "Chromosome" )

plotRatioDensity(f_se, groupings = "annotation.Chromosome", treatment1 = 
"Male", treatment2 = "Female", type = "l", xlab = "Log(Male:Female)",
ylab = "Density", col=c(rep("grey80", 20), "red"), lty = 1)

za.ratios.test <- test_diffs(f_se, groupings = "annotation.ZA", 
treatment1 = "Male", treatment2 = "Female", LOG2 = FALSE )
za.ratios.test$summary
za.ratios.test$kruskal
lapply(za.ratios.test$data, head)
